summary: An excerpt from the novel 'Book 15 — part 99' in which investigators question Bobby Diggs, a security guard on the ship, about a suspect who may have entered a cargo bay and come down a ladder. Ray and Rodriguez discuss how the suspect got past the lock, whether he had a stolen access card or was a crew member, and plan to check access card reports with equipment and accounting and the lock's access log via Becker. Ray asks Diggs to retell his whole shift from the start, including minor details, and Diggs recalls people, franchises, conversations, cigarettes, lights and maintenance closets with notable precision.
one_line: Investigators question guard Bobby Diggs about how a suspect reached a cargo bay, probing lock access, missing key cards, and crew involvement.
key_facts: Diggs reasons that if the suspect had come down on the lift, he would have known, unless it happened on a different shift.
Ray suggests the suspect came down one of the ladders, calling it 'Gruesome work.'
Rodriguez asks how the suspect got into the bay, suggesting a card for the lock or a way to jimmy the lock undetected.
Diggs says the lock would not take a rocket scientist and that the area is not a secure zone, except port and starboard, where the dumps are.
Kilgore concludes the suspect either swiped a card or is a member of the crew.
Kilgore plans to talk to 'my ladies in equipment and accounting' in the morning about reports of missing access cards.
Ray asks Rodriguez to talk to Becker or one of his lieutenants to have the locks switched and the original handed over for analysis.
Ray says the lock's access log should show something anomalous if the suspect had no card.
Ray has seen Diggs's official report but believes things are sometimes left out of such reports.
Ray asks Diggs to tell everything from the point he came on shift last night, including unimportant details.
Diggs has a startling memory for details, recalling the franchises people represented and what they discussed.
Diggs remembers the gangways he traveled, which lights were out, and how many cigarettes he smoked.
Diggs recalls pulling bulbs from a particular maintenance closet at roughly a certain time.
Diggs says, 'Round about ten, I leave the' before the excerpt breaks off.
